qa_pair.question: Run the Vieta-jumping descent workflow on the positive pair a = 30, b = 112. Require the verdict quotient-is-square, require every descent step's product and invariant checks to be the kernel zero, and report only the certified square root of the quotient (a^2+b^2)/(a*b+1).
Run the Vieta-jumping descent workflow on a = 8, b = 57. Report only the returned verdict token, exactly as the tool prints it.

Use the certified factorization workflow on n = 561. Require a sealed-runtime Pratt certificate for every listed prime and a zero recomposition check, then report only the largest certified prime factor.
Use the certified lcm workflow on a = 462 and b = 1071. Require the Bezout gcd certificate and a zero gcd*lcm identity check, then report only the certified lcm.
Use the certified p-adic valuation workflow to compute v_2(40320). Require the kernel-verified decomposition n = p^v * cofactor with a non-divisible cofactor, then report only the valuation.
Use the certified square-decision workflow on n = 1234567654321. If the verdict is square, report only the certified root.
Use the certified congruence workflow to decide whether 123456789 and 987654321 are congruent modulo 9. Report only the returned congruent field token.
Use the certified modular square-root workflow on a = 2, p = 7. Require a sealed-runtime square certificate for each root and report the two roots in ascending order separated by one comma.

Use the certified linear Diophantine workflow on 1027*x + 712*y = 1. Require the Bezout certificate, a zero particular-solution check, and a zero homogeneous-step check, then report only the returned verdict token.

Use the certified Pell workflow on d = 61. Require a zero kernel identity check for x^2 - 61*y^2 = 1 and report only the fundamental x. Preserve the checked (not exact) fundamentality labeling in your working; it must not be promoted.

Use the modular obstruction workflow on the polynomial x^2 + y^2 - 3 with modulus 4 and variables x,y. Require all sixteen residue classes to be kernel-decided and report only the returned verdict token.
